verdict.rationale: No official Grok Build SDK package is evidenced. What the evidence does show are programmatic surfaces for building against it: headless mode with `json`/`streaming-json` output, an ACP agent over JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout (corroborated by a community comment about building custom bots and orchestration), and a published xAI API OpenAPI spec for dropping the model into your own agent loop. These are protocol- and spec-level integration points rather than official SDKs. missing for 10: named official SDK libraries (e.g. Python/TypeScript) for Grok Build or the xAI API, SDK documentation and examples, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
